mapper.select: SELECT post_id, board_type_code, user_id, title, content, visibility_status, pinned_yn, created_at, view_count, updated_at, deleted_yn FROM sd_board_post WHERE board_type_code = 'NOTICE' AND visibility_status = 'PUBLIC' AND deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY pinned_yn DESC, created_at DESC, post_id DESC

SELECT post_id, board_type_code, user_id, title, content, visibility_status, pinned_yn, created_at, view_count, updated_at, deleted_yn FROM sd_board_post WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND board_type_code = 'NOTICE' AND visibility_status = 'PUBLIC' AND deleted_yn = 'N'

WITH notice_list AS ( SELECT post_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY pinned_yn DESC, created_at DESC, post_id DESC ) AS rn FROM sd_board_post WHERE board_type_code = 'NOTICE' AND visibility_status = 'PUBLIC' AND deleted_yn = 'N' ), current_notice AS ( SELECT rn FROM notice_list WHERE post_id = #{postId} ) SELECT notice_list.post_id FROM notice_list, current_notice WHERE notice_list.rn = current_notice.rn - 1 LIMIT 1
